name: Abéo S.A.
summary: Abéo SA, together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, and distributes sports and leisure equipment in France and internationally. The company offers gymnastics apparatus and landing mats, team sports equipment, physical education, climbing walls, and changing room fittings. It also provides assistance in implementing projects to professional customers in specialized sports halls and clubs, leisure centers, education, local authorities, construction professionals, and other sectors. The company is headquartered in Rioz, France.
